name: wechat
description: Read and summarize local WeChat (macOS 4.x) chat history by decrypting on-disk SQLCipher databases — local-only, read-only, never automates the WeChat client

interface.shortDescription: Read and summarize local WeChat chat history on macOS by decrypting the on-disk databases.
interface.longDescription: Read, extract, and summarize local WeChat (macOS 4.x) group and private chat history by decrypting the on-disk SQLCipher databases — strictly local and read-only, never automating the WeChat client (zero ban risk). Ships a one-time setup manual (temporarily disable SIP to capture the passphrase via an lldb breakpoint on CCKeyDerivationPBKDF, re-enable SIP, grant Full Disk Access) and a decrypt/query pipeline (decrypt, list groups, search contacts, dump a group's transcript over a time range).
defaultPrompt: Summarize what a WeChat group discussed over the last few days.
Extract and search my local WeChat chat history.
